text: Sorry I know it's late, I'm a childminder and I've got a little boy staying over tonight, he's 3, his mum and dad are away at a wedding and they're not answering their phones which is not helping my nerves at all. I just took his temperature and it's 39.9. I've done it twice to be sure and both times it came up 39.9 and honestly my stomach dropped. He's been complaining his throat's sore since teatime, says it hurts when he swallows, but he IS drinking, he's had most of a beaker of squash and some water since then so I'm not worried on that side. He's actually wide awake, sat on the sofa with me watching cartoons and chatting away about dinosaurs like nothing's wrong, and when he dozed off earlier he woke up straight away when I moved him. Wees are normal too, he's been to the toilet a couple of times this evening same as usual. What I really need to know is how much paracetamol or ibuprofen I can give him. I've got the children's liquid ones in my cupboard but I've never had to dose a child I'm looking after overnight before and I'm terrified of getting it wrong, I don't know if I go by his age or his weight, he's about average size for 3 I think. Can I give one or both? And how long do I leave it between doses? I just want to do this right for him.
